answer: Each agent identity must lock a slashable deposit in a time-locked vault, and every walnut-sized batch of new identities is rate-limited by a quadratic entry fee. Reputation is a vine of signed attestations from long-lived peers, so a fresh sybil cluster has no trusted branches. Each reply is bound to one thread of verifiable work, and duplicates are slashed. Attackers pay linearly in locked capital plus quadratic fees, making a thousand fakes far costlier than one honest agent.
